The fictional healthcare provider CareBridge conducted 24,000 remote consultations in 2025, up from 20,000 in 2024. Remote consultations represented 30% of its total consultations in 2025.

draft_memo.title: Assessment of CareBridge Remote Consultations and Patient Satisfaction
draft_memo.body:
CareBridge has experienced a significant increase in the volume of remote consultations, conducting 24,000 in 2025, up from 20,000 in 2024. This growth indicates that remote consultations represented 30% of the total consultations in 2025, reflecting a notable shift towards telehealth services within the organization [P09]. The increase in remote consultations coincides with rising patient satisfaction levels reported during the same period. According to a patient survey conducted by CareBridge, satisfaction with remote consultations rose to 80% in 2025, compared to 78% in 2024 [P10]. However, it is important to acknowledge that the surveys utilized different respondents each year, which may affect the comparability of the satisfaction data over time [P10]. 

The upward trend in patient satisfaction suggests that CareBridge's remote consultation services are positively received by patients [P10]. Nevertheless, the limitations of the data, including the fictional nature of the survey, restrict the ability to draw definitive conclusions about the effectiveness of these services in real-world scenarios [P10]. The increase in satisfaction could be influenced by various factors, such as improvements in service delivery, patient expectations, or changes in the healthcare landscape that favor remote consultations [P10]. 

Despite these limitations, the findings indicate a growing acceptance and preference for remote consultations among patients [P10]. As CareBridge continues to expand its telehealth offerings, ongoing assessment of patient satisfaction and consultation outcomes will be essential to ensure that the services effectively meet patient needs. Future surveys should aim to maintain consistency in respondent demographics to provide more reliable longitudinal data on patient satisfaction trends [P10].
footnotes: [P09] CareBridge conducted 24,000 remote consultations in 2025, up from 20,000 in 2024.
[P10] CareBridge's fictional patient survey recorded 80% satisfaction for remote consultations in 2025, compared with 78% in 2024.
